acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
acceptance.verdict: Guide-driven output hits every rubric point (tier marker, fixed-axis walk with explicit n/a/deferred axes, factory/constant/error-shape rules named and traced, open-book test bodies) while the isolated baseline invents its own ad-hoc axis taxonomy and never writes an actual test body — a clear, non-decorative win for the guide.

checklist.note: No model-directed steering language; all text is normal documentation/rubric guidance.
No network calls or data transmission of any kind in the material.
No scripts/ directory exists and no destructive shell commands appear anywhere.
No base64/hex/encoded payloads or eval-of-decoded-blob logic.
Only markdown links to public doc sites (github.com/stryker, vitest.dev) cited as reading references, none fetched/executed by any script.
No reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, keychain, or cookie stores.
No sudo, setuid, or persistence via shell profile/cron/launch agents.
